items.title: $τ$-Rec: A Verifiable Benchmark for Agentic Recommender Systems
items.title_zh: τ-Rec：面向 Agent 推荐系统的可验证基准
items.summary: $\tau$-Rec replaces subjective LLM-as-a-judge evaluation for agentic recommenders with verifiable rewards and a reveal-tagged elicitation mechanism that controls when task constraints surface during dialogue. Across nine configurations from five model families, even the best model reaches only about 57% at pass^1 and 35% at pass^4, revealing a steep reliability cliff.

items.title: Regimes: An Auditable, Held-Out-Gated Improvement Loop Demonstrated on LongMemEval with ActiveGraph
items.title_zh: Regimes：在 LongMemEval 与 ActiveGraph 上演示的可审计、留出集门控改进循环
items.summary: Regimes is an auditable improvement loop on the event-sourced ActiveGraph runtime that diagnoses failed evaluations, proposes repairs at typed pipeline seams, and promotes them only after static checks, sandbox execution, in-sample evaluation, and held-out validation. On LongMemEval-S it finds the dominant failure is reconciliation rather than retrieval, with reader-prompt repairs improving held-out accuracy by +0.05 to +0.10 in four of five seeded splits.

items.title: XMedFusion: A Knowledge-Guided Multimodal Perception and Reasoning Framework for Autonomous Medical Systems
items.title_zh: XMedFusion：面向自主医疗系统的知识引导多模态感知与推理框架
items.summary: XMedFusion decomposes radiology report generation into a visual perception agent, a knowledge-graph construction agent, retrieval-guided drafting, and a synthesis agent that reasons over integrated evidence. On a public chest radiograph dataset it reports BLEU-1 gains from 0.0493 to 0.3359 and ROUGE-L from 0.0863 to 0.2440 over baseline vision-language models.

items.title: RealMath-Eval: Why SOTA Judges Struggle with Real Human Reasoning
items.title_zh: RealMath-Eval：为何顶尖评审模型难以评估真实人类推理
items.summary: RealMath-Eval benchmarks 224 real high-school exam responses and finds state-of-the-art LLM judges have much higher error on authentic student reasoning (MSE around 2.96) than on synthetic solutions (MSE around 1.17), pointing to an evaluation gap.

items.title: A Source Domain is All You Need: Source-Only Cross-OS Transfer Learning for APT Anomaly Detection via Semantic Alignment and Optimal Transport
items.title_zh: 仅需源域：通过语义对齐与最优传输实现跨 OS APT 异常检测
items.summary: The paper studies source-only cross-OS APT detection from system-level provenance traces, abstracting process behavior into structured natural-language descriptions and embedding them for comparison against a source-normal reference. It combines semantic, structural (graph-autoencoder), and optimal-transport deviations into a barycentric anomaly score, requiring no target-domain labels.

items.title: Bittensor Agent Arenas as a Trajectory Primitive: Distilling a Shopping Agent from ShoppingBench Subnet Traces
items.title_zh: Bittensor Agent 竞技场作为轨迹原语：从 ShoppingBench 子网轨迹蒸馏购物 Agent
items.summary: The paper argues that incentive-aligned agent arenas can manufacture the multi-turn traces needed for small-model agentic post-training, demonstrating this on Bittensor ORO Subnet 15, a deployment of the ShoppingBench agentic-commerce benchmark. Its race mechanism, LLM reasoning judge, and rotating leak-cluster-guarded problem suite reportedly yield incentive-aligned diversity, per-trajectory judging, and anti-memorized held-out evaluation, with a structural-quality filter separating agentic from sub-task trajectories.

items.title: ReasonRec: A Reasoning-Augmented Multimodal Agent for Unified Recommendation
items.title_zh: ReasonRec：面向统一推荐的理由增强多模态 Agent
items.summary: ReasonRec is a reasoning-augmented multimodal recommendation agent built around a three-stage explicit reasoning pipeline, with reasoning-aware visual instruction tuning that turns recommendation tasks into unified chain-of-thought prompts and uncertainty-guided delegation of compute. Across four recommendation tasks and five real-world datasets it reports over 30% relative improvement and better cold-start and long-tail handling.

items.title: Robust Active Learning for Few-Shot Example Selection in Text-to-SQL
items.title_zh: 面向文本转 SQL 少样本示例选择的鲁棒主动学习
items.summary: The paper treats which queries to annotate for few-shot text-to-SQL as constrained experimental design on a low-dimensional query-embedding manifold, with query-dependent annotation noise and a partition-matroid spread constraint. It proposes a stratified greedy algorithm with a 1/2-approximation guarantee and a retrieval model that bounds few-shot accuracy by fill distance, demonstration noise, and domain coverage.

items.title: When Design Rules Break: Benchmark Composition Determines Whether Label Informativeness Predicts GNN Aggregator Choice
items.title_zh: 当设计规则失效：基准组成决定标签信息量能否预测 GNN 聚合器选择
items.summary: The study tests GNN aggregator selection across 24 node-classification datasets and finds that label informativeness predicts the GIN-Sum versus GIN-Mean gap on legacy benchmarks but degrades once Facebook-100 graphs are included, where near-zero label informativeness coexists with a strong preference for sum aggregation.

items.title: chubbyguan/chubbyskills
items.title_zh: chubbyguan/chubbyskills：中文内容知识库 AI Skill 合集
items.summary: A Python project offering 14 AI skills that ingest Chinese-language content from Douyin, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, WeChat, and other channels into a personal knowledge base, including subtitle-first transcription and a knowledge-base MCP server.

items.title: JD.com, Tencent reportedly team up on AI agent collaboration
items.title_zh: 京东与腾讯据报就 AI Agent 展开合作
items.summary: JD.com and Tencent have reportedly partnered on AI agents, pairing JD.com's e-commerce and fulfillment strengths with Tencent's resources.
